'''Camp Pa'aal Squadron''' was a nickname for the surviving [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] taken prisoner by the [[Yevetha]] and held as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on [[Pa'aal]].

==History==
When the Imperials, led by [[Sil Sorannan]], rebelled in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], they called themselves Camp Pa'aal Squadron. The Imperials, bearing no love for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] but despising their Yevetha captors even more, took control of their ships at a key juncture in the [[Battle of N'zoth]], killed most of the Yevetha crewmen, and escaped to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] throneworld of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Upon learning of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] destruction some years earlier, the squadron split up, with some joining the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], others defecting to the New Republic, and others departing for points unknown.
